subject: eastern glass lizard
title: This 'Snake' Breaks Into Pieces When You Grab It, and Lives

scenes.text: Grab this snake's tail, and the snake shatters into pieces.
The pieces keep wriggling on the ground, and the attacker usually goes for those.
But it's not a snake. It's the eastern glass lizard, and it has eyelids and ear holes.
Up to two thirds of its body is tail, built to snap off in several sections.
The front part, with the head, slips away into the grass.
Then it grows a new tail, shorter and paler. The pieces never rejoin. The lizard just starts again.

description:
The eastern glass lizard looks like a snake, but it is a legless lizard with eyelids and ear openings.
Up to two thirds of its length is tail, which breaks off in several wriggling sections when grabbed. It grows back, usually shorter and lighter.
Would you have guessed lizard or snake?
first_comment: An old legend says the pieces crawl back together. They don't, but the tail does grow back. Lizard or snake, which did you think it was?
